title: Restriction S⌞W of an integer multiplicity current in U, regarded as an integer multiplicity current in ℝ^P
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P open and W ⊆ ℝ^P open with W ⊂⊂ U (CompactlyContained W U: closure W is compact and closure W ⊆ U). Let S ∈ 𝒟_n(U) (GeometricCurrentOn U n) and let R = (M, θ, ξ) be an integer multiplicity representation of S in U (IMRep U n with R.Represents S). Then there are a current Q ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) (GeometricCurrentOn univ n) and an integer multiplicity representation R_Q of Q in ℝ^P (IMRep univ n with R_Q.Represents Q) with carrier M ∩ W, multiplicity θ and orientation ξ, such that: (Q1) Q(ιω) = S(ω) for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U) with tsupport ω ⊆ W, where ιω = testFormOnInclusion (U ⊆ ℝ^P) n ω is ω regarded as a test form on ℝ^P; and (Q2) spt Q ⊆ closure(W) ∩ spt S and spt Q is compact. (Q is S⌞W regarded as a current in ℝ^P; its weight is θHⁿ⌞(M ∩ W) = μ_S⌞W.)
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U W : Set (Euclid P)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n), IsOpen U → IsOpen W → CompactlyContained W U → R.Represents S → ∃ (Q : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (RQ : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), RQ.Represents Q ∧ RQ.carrier = R.carrier ∩ W ∧ RQ.mult = R.mult ∧ RQ.orient = R.orient ∧ (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) ⊆ W → Q (testFormOnInclusion (subset_univ U) n ω) = S ω) ∧ Q.support ⊆ closure W ∩ S.support ∧ IsCompact Q.support
